title: The big cactus group, invariant tensors, and rectangular tableaux
summary: The cactus group acts on tensor products of crystals and, through Bender--Knuth involutions, on semistandard Young tableaux. We show that the big cactus group $J'_n=π_1^{\mathfrak S_n}(\overline M_{0,n}(\mathbb R))$, $n\ge3$, is obtained from the cactus group by imposing $n-1$ Dynkin-reversal relations, which say that conjugation by the full reversal acts on the Bender--Knuth generators by the Dynkin diagram automorphism; the quotient map is induced by forgetting the distinguished marked point.
